defects: Replaces the specific weight-2 Eisenstein series E2 (a fixed, canonically defined function from Mathlib's EisensteinSeries library) with an arbitrary universally-quantified function parameter E_2 : ℂ → ℂ, so the theorem no longer asserts boundedness of the actual Eisenstein series but a generic (and in general false) claim about arbitrary functions
Loses the domain restriction to the upper half-plane ℍ; z ranges over all of ℂ rather than ℍ
Adds an unjustified positivity constraint C > 0 on the bound (harmless in effect but not part of the gold's IsBoundedAtImInfty notion, which only needs boundedness)
Does not use or reference the actual IsBoundedAtImInfty predicate/filter machinery, instead manually unfolding a bespoke (and mis-scoped) definition
